title: Cumulative Update Summary for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (May, 2026)
summary: This post announces the May 2026 cumulative update for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, covering version 28.1 for the 2026 Release Wave 1 and updates for earlier versions, including improved environment management in the Admin Center.
key_points: Version 28.1 released for 2026 Release Wave 1 with platform and application build numbers specified for both cloud and on-premises
Business Central Admin Center now displays full Country/Region names when creating new environments
Multiple versions actively supported: version 28 (2026 Wave 1) until Oct 2027, version 27 (2025 Wave 2) until Apr 2027, and version 26 (2025 Wave 1) until Oct 2026
On-premises versions follow Modern Lifecycle Policy with start and retirement dates published for all supported releases
End of Life status documented for versions 25 through 14, with version 14 reaching end of extended support in October 2025

quotes.text: When creating a new environment in the Business Central Admin Center, Microsoft now displays the full name of the Country/Region.
quotes.why_it_matters: This user experience improvement makes environment creation clearer and reduces ambiguity when selecting geographic regions for deployment
